description: This file defines the 'Order' entity class within the application core, representing an order in the e-commerce domain. It includes properties such as BuyerId, OrderDate, shipping address, and a collection of order items. The class enforces encapsulation and domain-driven design (DDD) patterns, providing methods to calculate totals and manage associated order items.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Represents a customer order in the e-commerce system, encapsulating order details, items, total calculation, and domain logic.

methods.name: Order
methods.description: Constructor initializing an order with buyer ID, shipping address, and order items, enforcing validation.

methods.name: Total
methods.description: Calculates the total amount for all order items.
